components.css: .ds-primary { display:inline-flex; padding:16px 24px; border-radius:10px; background:var(--blue,#1d4ed8); color:#fff; text-decoration:none; font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif; font-weight:650; } .ds-primary:hover { background:var(--blue-dark,#173da8); color:#fff; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--blue,#1d4ed8); outline-offset:5px; } @media(max-width:700px) { .ds-primary { padding:14px 22px; } }

components.name: Copy command button

components.css: .ds-copy { padding:7px 10px; background:var(--surface,#f8fafc); border:1px solid var(--line,#cbd5e1); border-radius:6px; color:var(--secondary,#334155); font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif; font-size:12px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-copy:hover { color:var(--blue,#1d4ed8); border-color:var(--blue,#1d4ed8); } .ds-copy:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--blue,#1d4ed8); outline-offset:5px; }

components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:30px; font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif; color:var(--ink,#0f172a); } .ds-nav a { padding-block:10px; font-size:14px; font-weight:550; text-decoration:none; color:inherit; } .ds-nav a:hover { color:var(--blue,#1d4ed8); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--blue,#1d4ed8); outline-offset:5px; } .ds-nav .ds-github { border:1px solid var(--line,#cbd5e1); border-radius:9px; padding:10px 18px; } @media(max-width:700px) { .ds-nav { gap:18px; } .ds-nav a:first-child { display:none; } .ds-nav a { font-size:13px; } .ds-nav .ds-github { padding:8px 10px; } }

narrative.overview:
The website carries the existing Chorus identity into a spacious, light public page. It uses the original four-color mark, cool white surfaces, navy text, and blue actions. The real dashboard supplies the product imagery; its example-data caption stays with it.

This records the implemented static page, rather than a new identity or a complete application component library. The visual source is [site/styles.css](site/styles.css), with markup in [site/index.html](site/index.html) and copy feedback in [site/site.js](site/site.js).
keyCharacteristics: Clear system sans-serif text and strongly sized headings.
Pale blue regions, softly rounded controls, and restrained borders.
A real dashboard screenshot and selectable installation commands.
dos: Do preserve the original four-color Chorus mark.
Do use blue for actions and keep keyboard focus clearly visible.
Do keep commands readable, wrapping, and selectable on mobile.
Do retain the example-data caption with the dashboard image.
donts: Don't substitute a new visual identity for the inherited dashboard identity.
Don't use the logo's brighter blue in place of the established darker action blue.
